name: SikaWrap FX-50 C
paste:
SIKAWRAP® FX-50 C: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaWrap® FX-50 C, October 2023, Version 05.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/sikawrap_fx-50_c.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaWrap® FX-50 C where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2023, Version 05.02).
1.2 Product description. SikaWrap® FX-50 C is a unidirectional carbon fibre string, encased in a plastic envelope, which is used as near surface mounted strengthening and as fibre connector for the anchorage of SikaWrap® fabrics.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaWrap® FX-50 C may only be used by experienced professionals.
    - Anchoring SikaWrap® carbon and glass fibre fabrics on concrete or masonry
    - Connecting SikaWrap® carbon or glass fibre fabrics through concrete or masonry structures
    - Flexible near surface mounted strengthening (NSM)
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaWrap® FX-50 C
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Carbon fibre string for structural strengthening and connection, and anchoring of SikaWrap® strengthening systems
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports.
    - France: Technical Approval, CSTB, Avis Technique 3.3/19-1005_V1
    - Poland: National Technical Assessment Sika Car?boDur® kit, ITB, No. ITB-KOT-2019/0415 v.1
    - Poland: Technical Approval Sika CarboDur, Nr. IB?DiM-KOT-2019-0361 v.1
    - Romania: Technical Agreement, CTPC, No. 016- 011401-2019
    - Russia: Certificate of conformity Sika® CarboDur®, No. ССС БК СH.ПБ10. H00278
    - Russia: Certificate, PCT, No. РОСС RU.AГ8l.H10831
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - ASTM D 4018: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Dry fibre elongation at break (p.1); Product Information > Dry fibre modulus of elasticity in tension (p.1); Product Information > Dry fibre tensile strength (p.1).
    - EN 2561: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Laminate modulus of elasticity in tension (p.2); Technical Information > Laminate tensile strength (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Carbon fibre, corrosion resistant, durable
    - Multifunctional use
    - Easy to install
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Dry fibre density: 1.82 g/cm³
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Construction: Unidirectional carbon fibre string encased in a plastic envelope
    - Fibre type: Carbon fibre
    - Dry fibre modulus of elasticity in tension: 240 kN/mm² (ASTM D 4018)
    - Dry fibre tensile strength: 4 000 N/mm² (ASTM D 4018)
    - Dry fibre elongation at break: ≥ 1.6 % (ASTM D 4018)
    - Cross section: ≥ 28 mm² (based on carbon fibre content)
    - Mass per length: ≥ 50 g/m (carbon fibre content)
    - Design nominal cross section: 78 mm²
    - Laminate tensile strength: ~2 000 N/mm² (related to fibre cross section)* (EN 2561**)
    - Laminate modulus of elasticity in tension: ~230 kN/mm² (related to fibre cross section)* (EN 2561**)
2.7 System structure. The system build-up and configuration as described must be fully complied with and may not be changed.
    | Impregnating / laminating resin op- | Sikadur®-300 |
    | tions | Sikadur®-52 |
    | Anchorage resin | Sikadur®-330 |
    | Sika AnchorFix®-3001 |
    | Sika AnchorFix®-3030 |
    | Structural strengthening fabric | SikaWrap® carbon or glass fibre |
    | fabric |
    | The embedded composite will have a diameter of approx. 10 mm. |
    (System build-up table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows. Refer to the data sheet (page 2) for the layout.)
    For detailed information on Sikadur®-330, Sikadur®-300, Sikadur-52, AnchorFix®-3001, Sika AnchorFix®-3030, together with the resin and fabric application details, please refer to the relevant Product Data Sheets and the Method Statements.
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 25 m roll on a plastic reel dispenser
    - Shelf life: 5 years from date of production
    - Storage conditions: Store in undamaged, original sealed packaging, in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Protect from direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2023, Version 05.02) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality.
    - Minimum substrate tensile strength: 1.0 N/mm² or as specified in the strengthening design.
    - Please also refer to the relevant Method Statement for further information.
3.3 Substrate preparation. Concrete must be cleaned and prepared to achieve a laitance and contaminant free, open textured surface. Please also refer to the relevant Method Statement for further information.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2023, Version 05.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: Anchor impregnation: 110–150 g/m; SikaWrap® fabrics: Please refer to the relevant product data sheet
4.3 Application method / tools. SikaWrap® FX-50 C can be cut with special scissors. Please refer to the relevant Method Statement for installation of SikaWrap® FX and for the impregnating / laminating procedure of the fabrics.
4.4 Limitations and important considerations.
    - SikaWrap® FX-50 C shall only be applied by trained and experienced professionals.
    - A specialist structural engineer must be consulted for any structural strengthening design calculation.
    - Notes and limitations mentioned in the Method Statement installation of SikaWrap® FX (Ref. 850 41 09) must be respected.
    - The SikaWrap® products are coated to ensure maximum bond and durability with the Sikadur® adhesives / impregnating / laminating resins. To maintain and ensure full system compatibility, do not interchange different system components.
    - The SikaWrap® system can be over coated with a cementitious overlay or other coatings for aesthetic and / or protective purposes. The over coating system selection is dependent on the exposure and the project specific requirements. For additional protection against UV light in exposed areas use Sikagard®- 550 W Elastic, Sikagard® ElastoColor-675 W or Sikagard®-680 S.
    - Please refer to the Method Statement of SikaWrap® manual dry application (Ref. 850 41 02), SikaWrap® manual wet application (Ref. 850 41 03) or SikaWrap® machine wet application (Ref. 850 41 04) for further information, guidelines and limitations.
4.5 Further information - Method Statements.
    - Ref. 850 41 09: Installation of SikaWrap® FX
    - Ref. 850 41 02: SikaWrap® manual dry application Ref. 850 41 03: SikaWrap® manual wet application Ref. 850 41 04: SikaWrap® machine wet application

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (October 2023, Version 05.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Dry fibre modulus of elasticity in tension: 240 kN/mm² (ASTM D 4018)
    - Dry fibre tensile strength: 4 000 N/mm² (ASTM D 4018)
    - Dry fibre elongation at break: ≥ 1.6 % (ASTM D 4018)
    - Laminate tensile strength: ~2 000 N/mm² (related to fibre cross section)* (EN 2561**)
    - Laminate modulus of elasticity in tension: ~230 kN/mm² (related to fibre cross section)* (EN 2561**)
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaWrap® FX-50 C, October 2023, Version 05.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/sikawrap_fx-50_c.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
